Agent Name: Coder
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Coder made a fundamental error in data retrieval and logic. Instead of finding the actual absolute numbers of men and women with tertiary education from the 2011 Bulgarian census (which were approximately 212,000 men and 447,000 women, resulting in a difference of ~235,000 or 234.9k), the Coder relied on incorrect percentage data (21.5% and 29.3%) and an arbitrary total population estimate (7.36 million) to calculate a fabricated result (287.8). This approach ignored the specific census data which likely provided the exact counts, leading to a mathematically consistent but factually wrong answer.
